title: Book Coastal Cottage | Beach View 30A Cottage | Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: Coastal Cottage is one of our favorite rentals, with beautiful views and a spacious layout. Click here to book this beach view 30A cottage now!
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Guests who visit Coastal Cottage for the first time are always impressed by its beautiful design, inside and out. Located in a quiet area off West Water Street, it's a perfect destination for families or business retreats. It's close to the beautiful Cabana Pool and kiddie splash pad and is well-loved for its amazing outdoor patio and grill area as well as the small patio on the front porch.

Coastal Cottage is is comfortable and roomy with lots of natural light. The open design allows you to see what's going on in other rooms easily-which is great for families who need to keep an eye on the kids. The living area, on the first floor, has a flat screen TV and DVD player, which you can watch on the cushy sofas and chairs. The kitchen is right off the living area and has space for four at the breakfast bar and six more at the dining table on the other side. The kitchen is well-equipped, with top-of-the-line stainless steel appliances and beautiful white counter tops and cabinets.

The bedrooms are on the second floor, with two master suites. Each master suite has a king bed and a private bathroom, as well as its own terrace with bistro table and chairs. The children's room is on the third floor and has amusing slanted ceilings and four twin beds.

Street parking only.

When you want to get out of the house for a bit, just take the four adult bikes provided for your use. Check out restaurants and cafes in town or ride down to the beach and enjoy the sun and surf. You can also head to the Cabana Pool or just enjoy a little exercise in the beautiful Florida landscapes. Take a ride through the outskirts of town and watch the stunning Gulf Coast sunrise or sunset.

This property requires a 7 night minimum stay, Saturday to Saturday during spring break and summer and a 4 night minimum stay during shoulder season.
